metadataRaw.title: How to Relieve Upper Trapezius Pain FAST (Try This First!)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows you how to quickly relieve upper trapezius tightness and pain.

The upper trapezius is a common source of pain and stiffness around the base of the neck and top of the shoulder. In many cases, it comes from tight, weak muscles and irritated tendons.
In this video, you’ll learn simple exercises designed to both stretch and strengthen the area for fast, lasting relief.

For the best results, try all of the exercises and stick with the ones that feel the most helpful for you.

Even better, everything can be done at home and may help relieve upper back and shoulder pain in as little as 30 seconds.

Watch now and start getting rid of upper trapezius pain for good!
